subject: MAP & temporary promptpack custody — provisioning windows and takedown SLA
messages:
From: Sarah Park <sarah@optiretail.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Eval samples & MAP draft — provisional timeline

Markus / Lauren —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As discussed, OptiRetail is prepared to provide a curated promptpack and a ~5k sample test corpus for Redwood to run our acceptance/eval pipeline. Before we transfer anything we need a short mutual action plan (MAP) that covers:

- Who has access (users + roles)
- Allowed usage (no external redistribution, model outputs may be retained for debugging for up to 30 days)
- Retention & destruction timeline after test window
- Audit evidence we can request (access logs, download receipts)

Attached: OptiRetail-MAP-Draft.docx and Sample-Labeling-Guide.pdf — the doc has redlines from our legal team (highlighted). Proposed runway: transfer by Monday 2026-08-16, 2-week ephemeral access window, complete takedown and certificate of destruction by 2026-08-31.

Can Redwood confirm that ephemeral sandbox keys + per-prompt call quotas are available, and that we can automate takedown on your side once the window closes?

Thanks —
Sarah Park
Director, ML Partnerships
OptiRetail

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval samples & MAP draft — provisional timeline

Sarah —

Appreciate the clear draft and timeline. High-level confirmation: Redwood can provide ephemeral sandbox credentials scoped to a single project, per-key call quotas, and an automated takedown workflow that emits a signed confirmation (certificate of destruction). A few notes/questions from our side before we mark the MAP final:

1) Access list: please confirm primary reviewer emails (we need explicit user emails for the audit log).
2) Retention: Redwood can hold logs for 90 days by default; we can provide a filtered export to OptiRetail on request within that window.
3) Output retention: we can implement a 30-day purge policy for model outputs derived from sample runs; want to confirm whether OptiRetail needs any longer retention for debugging.
4) Scope: we prefer that promptpack/testcases remain behind OptiRetail-designated gating (no dataset sharing with third parties). We will require a signed MPA + SOW for the provisioning step.

I attached our redwood-mpa-template.docx to accelerate the legal back-and-forth. Proposed MAP milestones (working draft):

- 2026-08-13: Exchange signed MPA + SOW (digital signature OK)
- 2026-08-16: Secure transfer to Redwood ephemeral sandbox (S3 ACL + signed access)
- 2026-08-16 - 2026-08-30: Evaluation window (two weeks)
- 2026-08-31: Takedown + cert of destruction delivered to OptiRetail Legal

Ben (cc) — can you weigh in on provisioning cadence and the access matrix? Lauren — loop in Legal if the OptiRetail redlines are non-starters.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, Sarah Park <sarah@optiretail.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval samples & MAP draft — provisioning checklist and access matrix

Sarah / Markus —

Quick operational checklist and controls we will apply for the ephemeral promptpack run: 

- Provisioning: one project-space, isolated GPU nodes, ephemeral S3 bucket with object-level ACLs.
- Keys: time-limited API keys (TTL = length of eval window + 2 hours), scoped to read-only for the promptpack bucket and to the specific Redwood model endpoint we agree on.
- Throttles: per-key QPS cap (recommended 50 QPS) and total token cap (we recommend starting with 1M token cap for the 2-week window; can bump if needed).
- Logging & audit: every prompt and response logged; export CSV by date range on request.
- Output handling: outputs marked as "ephemeral-test-output" and scheduled for deletion 30 days after generation; we can produce a signed deletion report.

I attached a small access matrix csv mapping roles to permissions. Lina (infra) will create the sandbox the morning of 2026-08-16 once we have the signed docs and the final user list.

If OptiRetail needs stricter constraints (no output logging at all) we can provide a one-off blinded-run mode but that limits root-cause debugging.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: promptpack-access-matrix.csv (csv stub)

From: Sarah Park <sarah@optiretail.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@optiretail.com, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@retailops.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval samples & MAP draft — provisioning checklist and access matrix

Thanks Ben — this is exactly the kind of granularity we needed. A few quick clarifications from Legal and Engineering: 

- User list: we will send a finalized CSV with reviewer emails by EOD Friday 2026-08-14.
- Token cap: OptiRetail requests a 2M token cap (we expect a heavier pass in week 1).
- Output logging: Legal asked whether we can limit logging to metadata-only for the first 48 hours (no full prompt captures) and then enable full captures for the remaining window if we need to escalate debugging. Can Redwood support that staged logging?
- Takedown SLA: we need cert of destruction within 48 hours of the takedown trigger (not later than 2026-09-02 if the window ends 2026-08-31).

We will upload the final MAP + sign via DocuSign later today. DocuSign envelope id: DOCU-OPTR-2026-001 (link will be in the Drive folder).

—Sarah
